themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas are actively building electoral momentum, forging strategic pacts, and rallying base supporters ahead of upcoming contests. In Spain, Vox and the PP sealed Senate agreements across provinces, while Sweden's Tidö bloc gains ground, Norway's FrP reaches poll highs, and MAGA rallies intensify across the US.

themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Following his presidential election loss, Flávio Bolsonaro fled Brazil via Argentina to the United States while continuing to claim political legitimacy from abroad. His departure has sparked international diplomatic friction between Argentina's Milei administration and Brazil's Lula government, alongside US backing for visas.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands

Factions in France, Spain, Sweden, Norway, and the US are promoting measures to restrict welfare and housing to native citizens while pressing for aggressive enforcement.

themes.title: US Diplomatic Backing for Viktor Orbán's International Stature
themes.blurb: Reports indicate the US administration is backing Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán for high-level international roles, including UN Secretary-General. This diplomatic support underscores an ongoing transnational alignment between American conservative leadership and Hungary's sovereignist model.
